scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm --prefix functions run build && firebase deploy
scripts.e2e: npm run reset:emulator && npm run seed:emulator && node scripts/e2e/run.mjs
scripts.e2e:auth: npm run reset:emulator && npm run seed:emulator && node scripts/e2e-auth.mjs
scripts.e2e:survey: npm run reset:emulator && npm run seed:emulator && node scripts/e2e-survey.mjs
scripts.e2e:festival: npm --prefix functions run build && npm run reset:emulator && npm run seed:emulator && node scripts/e2e-festival.mjs
scripts.e2e:rating: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-rating "GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-rating node functions/lib/seed.js --emulator && GCLOUD_PROJECT=demo-rating node scripts/e2e-rating.mjs"
scripts.test:points: npm --prefix functions run build && node --test scripts/test-points.cjs
scripts.test:sessions: npm --prefix functions run build && node --test scripts/test-sessions.cjs
scripts.demo:points: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-point-demo "node scripts/demo-points.cjs"
scripts.test:sessions:emulator: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-prize-sessions "node --test scripts/test-sessions-emulator.cjs"
scripts.test:points:emulator: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-point-adjustments "node --test scripts/test-points-emulator.cjs"
